body.title: Stochastic Processes II
body.description: This course builds on ST3236 and introduces an array of stochastic models with biomedical and other real world applications. Topics include Poisson process, compound Poisson process, marked Poisson process, point process, epidemic models, continuous time Markov chain, birth and death processes, martingale. This course is targeted at students who are interested in Statistics and are able to meet the pre-requisites.
body.prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate DegreeTHEN( must have completed 1 of MA3238/MA3238S/ST3236 at a grade of at least D)
body.preclusion: If undertaking an Undergraduate DegreeTHEN( must not have completed ST4238 at a grade of at least D)
